name: Dynamic Sigma Scheduler (no-model re-derivation)
plain: Reimplements core schedulers and model sigma tables from scratch for a named profile, so a schedule can be previewed without loading a model. Adds a rescale to user start and end sigmas, a curve factor, and per-step manual edits.
math:
Tables: SDXL linear-β table or flow/flux shift tables rebuilt with same formulas as core.
Then σ' = end + (σ−old_end)/(old_start−old_end)·(start−end), endpoints forced.

props.params: model_profile, scheduler, steps, shift, sigma_start, sigma_end, curve_factor, smooth_strength

label: from code
surprise: Its ddim and beta versions do not match core: ddim forces exactly steps entries, and beta skips core's repeat removal (sigma_math.py:297-298, 310-317).
